import json,subprocess,sys
# final spot-checks of key edge behaviours
ok=[]
def run(doc):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return json.loads(p.stdout), p.returncode, p.stderr
base=json.load(open('/app/examples/input.json'))
# empty packets + connections
d=dict(base); d=dict(base); d2={"version":1,"config":base["config"],"model":base["model"],"connections":[],"packets":[]}

ok.append(("empty everything", rc==0 and out["packets"]==[] and out["jobs"]==[] and out["connections"]==[] and out["reports"]["dev"]["connections"]==0 and out["reports"]["dev"]["macro_f1"]==[0,1]))
# connections only, no packets
d3={"version":1,"config":base["config"],"model":base["model"],"connections":base["connections"],"packets":[]}
out,rc,err=run(d3)
ok.append(("connections w/o packets", rc==0 and out["connections"][2]["packets"]==0 and out["connections"][2]["prediction"] is None and out["connections"][2]["votes"]==[0,0]))
# bytes: stdout small, stderr empty
ok.append(("stderr empty", err==b""))
# invalid input form
out,rc,err=run({"version":2})
ok.append(("invalid -> error object", out=={"error":"invalid-input"} and rc==0))
for name,v in ok: print("   %-26s %s" % (name, "PASS" if v else "FAIL"))
assert all(v for _,v in ok)
print("4) edge spot-checks: PASS")
